clips.script: Welcome, robot builders! Build a robot that carries a paper parcel and stops at a red line. Try it, write down what happens, and make one thing better.
Show your robot a color. What message will appear? Make a prediction, then try it. Keep the wheels still. Explain how your rule picked the message.
Make a short drive, then stop. Measure how far your robot moves. Try three runs with the same settings. Do the distances match? Write down what you notice.
Build a holder for your paper parcel. Leave room for the wheels and sensor. Try it three times. Change one part of the holder, then test again.
Can your robot tell red from white? Test the colors with the wheels still. Write every reading. Change one thing, such as the sensor height, and try again.
Plan your route with arrows. Drive, turn, then drive again. Test each part on the floor. Change one time setting and try again. Did your robot get closer?
White means move a little. Red means stop. If the color is unknown, stop and check. Try your rule slowly. Keep the robot stopped until you start a new test.
Time for a delivery! Keep the parcel on, stop in the right place, and hit nothing. Try three runs. Write what happened each time, then choose one improvement.
Show your robot and tell its story. What did you change? What did your tests show? Explain one thing that works well and one thing you still want to improve.
